title: FormControl stamps the label's target id on a non-labelable wrapper, so Slug, Tags and Sidebar Width have no accessible name
statement: FormLabel renders `htmlFor={`${id}-form-item`}` and FormControl puts that same id on whatever element the render prop's root happens to be. Where the render prop is a wrapper rather than the real control the id lands on a <fieldset> (Slug), a <div> (Tags) or a div[role=group] slider root (Sidebar Width), none of which a <label> can name, so the actual input, chip field and slider thumb are anonymous to assistive technology and to any name-based query. Correctly wired fields on the same pages resolve normally, so the pattern, not the page, is the fault.

handVerified.note: Headline reproduced to the character: label "Name" for=_r_3a_-form-item resolves to INPUT, label "Slug" to FIELDSET, label "Tags" to DIV, and "Sidebar Width" to DIV[role=group]. The report explicitly corrected TWO sub-claims of the corpus write-up that must NOT be filed: (a) it is not 'fifteen anonymous spinbuttons', there are 15 spinbuttons of which exactly 2 are anonymous (Picture Size and the Sidebar Width numeric); (b) 3 of the 5 cited call sites are not instances (typography.tsx:155 and :189 use the correct InputGroup > FormControl render={InputGroupInput} nesting and measure as correctly named; api-key/create.tsx:224 is a bare read-only InputGroup with no FormControl at all). The same pass found a second, different defect family instead: FormLabels whose for= names an id no element in the document carries (Picture > Size, Basics > Website), and a duplicate DOM id (_r_jv_-form-item appears twice) because layout/index.tsx puts two FormControls inside one FormItem.

reevaluation: The finding stands exactly as re-verified, and the tracker position is unchanged: #2844 is the only accessibility item open and it is about the rendered resume document, not the builder chrome. The maintainer's 2026-08-16 request on that thread actually improves the case for filing: he asked for a narrow, concrete accessibility problem with current behaviour, expected behaviour and acceptance criteria, which is what this finding is. The filing must carry the report's corrections rather than the corpus's original wording, or the first maintainer to open the builder will find 13 correctly-named spinbuttons and two accurate call sites among the five and discount the whole report. Confidence is high on the headline and on the two extra families, which were measured live rather than read out of the source.
